notes: Background: GardenBay builds a mid-market product analytics and in-app help assistant. Recently trialed Redwood hosted API for generative help flows + embedding-based document search.
Decision path: product + infra evaluate hosted first (quick integration) -> if latency, cost, and residency OK move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and better unit economics.
Hosted trial summary (Jan-Feb 2026): integrated chat widget + nightly batch embedding job. Collected usage patterns over 4 weeks of production-like traffic.
Key POC metrics observed during hosted trial:
- Peak observed QPS (short bursts): 12 QPS
- Sustained QPS during business hours: 5-8 QPS
- Typical request concurrency (client side): 18-40 concurrent sockets depending on region
- Average token mix per request: prompt ~120 tokens, generated ~230 tokens (avg total ~350 tokens/request)
- Request distribution: ~70% chat (low-latency generation), ~20% embeddings (128-768 dims), ~10% reranking/batch scoring
- Token-size distribution: ~25% <128 tokens, ~50% 128-512, ~25% >512
- Latency targets: product requires p95 < 200ms for short-chat (<=128 tokens) and p95 < 500ms for typical chat flows
Product feedback from trial: model quality OK; concerns about variability during region-wide bursts and telemetry granularity (token-level cost breakdown requested).
Cost sensitivity: CFO wants Dedicated to be <= 30% premium over hosted for committed volumes; goal is to drive unit cost down by 2–3x at scale with batching/quantization.
Dedicated sizing ask (initial): GardenBay asked Redwood for a sizing recommendation that supports expected growth to 50-80 QPS within 6 months with peak bursts to 200 QPS for 1-2 minute windows.
Redwood SE/POC assumptions discussed on call:
- Workload mix: 70% short-chat (avg 350 tokens), 20% embeddings (batch jobs at night), 10% reranking
- Target p95 latency for chat: <=250ms (service-level goal), with fallback to lower-cost variants under heavy load

- Suggested Dedicated footprint: equivalent of 4 x A100-80GB style GPUs for primary region (balanced for concurrency and KV cache), or 8 x A10G for cost-optimized config; include autoscale headroom for bursts
- KV cache and prefix caching recommended to cut common-reply token generation by ~30% for help-flows
- Batching policy: continuous batching for background reranking and embeddings; strict latency bypass for interactive chat
Traffic forecasting done by GardenBay (conservative):
- Month 0 (prod launch): sustained 10 QPS avg, peak 40 QPS -> daily tokens ~300M
- Month 3: sustained 30 QPS avg, peak 120 QPS -> daily tokens ~900M
- Month 6: sustained 60 QPS avg, peak 200 QPS -> daily tokens ~1.8B
Notes on forecasting methodology: GardenBay used hosted trial samples, client-side telemetry, and expected 2x ARR-driven adoption uplift. They added safety multipliers for burst headroom (+30%).

Security/compliance notes: must support SSO (SAML), SOC2 attestation, audit log retention 2 years, encryption keys in customer KMS. Data residency preference: primary US region; EU data subset for EU customers.
Meeting quotes: CTO: "If p95 slips above 300ms our conversion drops — we need consistent latency and deterministic throttling behavior."
AE (Marcus): "We should show model-variant fallback and exact cost per million tokens under the dedicated commit."
Next steps (short):
- Redwood to deliver Dedicated sizing proposal (GPU count/config), expected latency curves, and committed pricing by 2026-03-17
- Schedule 90-minute infra deep-dive (SAML + KMS + VPC egress) with GardenBay infra leads (target week of 2026-03-22)
- Product to share canonical prompt set and 48-hour traffic sample (sanitized) for Redwood perf tuning
Open items / blockers:
- Finance needs a 12-month committed pricing sheet for procurement
- GardenBay IdP certificate rotation schedule impacts go-live date
- Clarify embedding dimensionality and nightly batch window to size GPUs for throughput
Internal notes for AE/SE:
- Emphasize caching + batching wins in pricing discussion; show Optimize suggestions that reduce token churn
- Provide runbook for canary traffic and automatic fallback to hosted if Dedicated capacity issues arise
- Attach model-variant perf matrix (low-latency vs cost) in sizing proposal
Status summary: Qualified mid-market account; Hosted trial validated core UX; deterministic latency and committed pricing are gating move to Dedicated.
